					No – leased devices are not eligible for this Trade-In Promotion unless you are trading in a smartphone or tablet and purchase the leased device from your carrier before trading it in. Check with your carrier for details.

What if the device I'm trading in is declined?
						
							
							
						
					
				
				
					If your trade-in is declined, Samsung will return your device for free upon request, subject to certain conditions.

Do I need to remove all the personal information on my trade-in device before I send it?
						
							
							
						
					
				
				
					Yes. You must remove all confidential and personal data from your trade-in device before returning it to Samsung as well as passwords, locks and personal cloud backup and restore accounts and SIM and memory cards.Please note that Samsung assumes no responsibility for any personal information you leave on your device when you ship it back to us as a trade-in.

Do I need to remove SIM and memory cards from my trade-in device before I send it?
						
							
							
						
					
				
				
					Yes. Be sure to remove all SIM and memory cards before sending it to us. If you ship these items with your device, we cannot return them. Please note that Samsung assumes no responsibility for any personal information you leave on your device when you ship it back to us as a trade-in.

How do I remove all the personal information on my device before I trade it in?
						
							
							
						
					
				
				
					In addition, make sure that you remove all passwords, locks and personal cloud backup and restore accounts, SIM and memory cards before sending the device to Samsung. If these items are sent with your device, they will not be returned
Please note that Samsung assumes no responsibility for any personal information you leave on your device when you ship it back to us as a trade in.

How can I identify which device model I have?
						
							
							
						
					
				
				
					Go to the Settings or Options menu, scroll to the bottom of the list, and check 'About phone', 'About device' or similar. The device name and model number should be listed. Otherwise visit the manufacturer's website for instructions.

When I send in my trade-in device, should I include the charger, case or other accessories?
						
							
							
						
					
				
				
					No. You should only ship the device and essential accessories, such as the S-Pen for Galaxy phones or the charging case for wireless earbuds. You may keep any other accessories or cables, or else discard them following your local trash and recycling regulations. Trade-in value is available only for the device. If you do ship accessories back with the device we will not return them.

How should I pack my trade-in device for shipment?
						
							
							
						
					
				
				
					Send your old device to Samsung in either the shipping box your new product arrived in or a box appropriate to the size of the device you are trading in. Place the device in the center of the box, cushioning the device on all sides with plenty of padding material such as recycled or reused packaging paper, bubble wrap, or packaging foam. Seal all open edges of the box with packing tape. Be sure to cover or remove previously used shipping labels from the box. Attach the provided shipping label to the outside of the box, taping all four sides of the label with clear packing tape.
For Galaxy Family Trade-In, each trade-in device must be sent in a individual box with the correct shipping label.

What if I lost or threw out the free trade-in shipping label?
						
							
							
						
					
				
				
					If you lost or discarded the shipping label, log in to your Samsung Account and reprint the label, which is available on the My Orders page. If you require additional assistance, please visit Customer Support.

What if I can't print my shipping label?
						
							
							
						
					
				
				
					You can have your label printed by FedEx. Save a copy of your pre-paid shipping label on your phone, tablet or laptop and take it to the FedEx Ship Center.

Can I send my trade-in device with a different shipper than FedEx?
						
							
							
						
					
				
				
					Yes. You can send your trade-in device by U.S. Postal Service, UPS, or other shipping method but you will be responsible for the shipping fees. Please note, you must include the bottom half of the pre-paid shipping label we sent you in the package to help us track your order accurately.

Can I trade in more than one device with the shipping label I received for my trade in?
						
							
							
						
					
				
				
					No. You should ship one device per trade-in label. We cannot offer a trade-in value for anything other than the one trade-in device your agreed to send when placing the order. You will receive a separate label for each trade-in order. If you placed more than one trade-in order or participated in the Galaxy Family Trade-In, please log in to your Samsung account and print the label for each trade-in from the My Orders page.

What do I have to do after I send my trade-in back to Samsung?
						
							
							
						
					
				
				
					You'll receive an email from Samsung when your device is received. We'll complete a trade-in review and send you a summary of the device condition approximately 5 business days later. As long as the device meets the criteria for acceptance, you do not need to do anything else.

What if I change my mind about trading in my device before I ship it to Samsung?
						
							
							
						
					
				
				
					You may keep it but the trade-in value will no longer apply. Approximately 15 days after you receive your new device, we'll charge you for the full retail price using the same payment method as your initial order. If sufficient credit is not available, we'll contact you for an alternate payment method.

My device did not qualify for the trade-in, can Samsung send it back to me?
						
							
							
						
					
				
				
					 Yes, but conditions apply. If we send you an offer to return the rejected trade-in device you must accept that offer within 7 days. The item will be shipped to the original return address provided at the time of purchase and a signature will be required upon delivery. If our authorized carrier cannot complete the delivery, the device will be sent back to Samsung and cannot be returned a second time. See the Samsung Trade-In-Program Terms and Conditions for more information.

If my device qualifies for the trade-in but I decide I want it back, can it be returned?
						
							
							
						
					
				
				
					No. When you ship your old device to us and it passes our trade-in review, you transfer ownership to Samsung. We cannot return any trade-in device accepted by the program.

Can I get my trade-in device back if I decide to return my new Samsung device?
						
							
							
						
					
				
				
					No. When you ship your old device to us and it passes our trade-in review, you transfer ownership to Samsung. We cannot return any trade-in device accepted by the program. You also will not receive a refund or other value for the trade-in credit deducted from the purchase price.

If Samsung rejects my trade-in device and returns it to me will I still get the trade-in value?
						
							
							
						
					
				
				
					No. The instant trade-in credit provided at checkout is a payment to you for your old device. After returning your trade-in to you, we will charge your payment account for the full trade-in value received during your purchase.

How can I track the trade-in device that is being sent back to me?
						
							
							
						
					
				
				
					 We will send you an email with a tracking number between 3 to 5 business days after hand off to our shipping partner. Signature is required upon delivery and if not received the item will be returned to Samsung and cannot be redelivered.

What if I have other questions?
						
							
							
						
					
				
				
					We'll be happy to assist you. You can view the Samsung Trade-In Program Terms and Conditions for more information or visit Samsung Customer Service for help.

What is the difference between Samsung instant credit and carrier bill credit?
						
							
							
						
					
				
				
					The Samsung Trade-In Program allows customers to trade in eligible devices such as smartphones, tablets, smartwatches, PCs, televisions & earbuds and receive an instant trade-in credit toward the purchase of a new qualifying Samsung device, such as Galaxy smartphones, tablets & wearables, TVs, and Bespoke Appliances.
The "Carrier Bill credit" is trade-in promotion for smartphones, tablets and wearable devices that allows you to trade in your eligible device in form of Bill credits, applied in monthly installments on your billing statements.
The Bill credit applies to your carrier account within 1-3 bill cycles after the carrier accepts your trade-in device.

If I buy a phone with carrier trade-in promotion, what do I do with my trade-in device?
						
							
							
						
					
				
				
					Once you complete the order with an eligible trade-in promotion, you will receive an email with the trade-in instructions.

Can I combine Samsung instant trade-in discount with carrier trade-in discounts?
						
							
							
						
					
				
				
					Instant Trade-in discount and Carrier Bill credits program are different promotions and cannot be combined.

I bought carrier locked phone. Do I send my old trade-in phone to the carrier?
						
							
							
						
					
				
				
					Once you complete the order with an eligible carrier trade-in promotion, you will receive an email with the instructions.

Will the carrier send me a shipping label for my trade-in?
						
							
							
						
					
				
				
					Yes, you will receive an email with trade-in instructions and prepaid shipping label.

Is trade-in shipping free?
						
							
							
						
					
				
				
					Yes, you will receive an email with instructions for prepaid shipping label.

Will the bill credit show up on my first bill?
						
							
							
						
					
				
				
					Once your trade-in device has been processed and meet eligibility requirements, you'll start receiving the trade-in bill credits on your carrier account.
Note: Promo bill credits can take 1-3 billing periods to appear.

If I decide to return my new carrier phone, can I get my old phone back?
						
							
							
						
					
				
				
					Device trade-ins are final. After you accept the trade-in credit and send your device to your carrier, you can't get the device back.

What happens to my carrier trade-in bill credit if I don't send my old trade-in device back?
						
							
							
						
					
				
				
					If you don't send us your old phone, you will still receive the device you purchased. However, you'll miss out on the bill credit trade-in value and promotional offer.
